status: published-prerelease; physical notification task and polling-process recovery verified
problem: During an actual Instinct task on Flyme, the AI could not locate notification-listener access through Settings. The prior command returned an action name but could not open its page.
change: event-configure --enable --open-settings explicitly opens the fixed normal Android notification-access page after the existing authority, lease and screen-recovery checks. It never grants permission. Omitting the option retains the no-screen behavior.
result_semantics: settings_opened means Android accepted the launch, not that the permission was granted or a notification arrived. Observe the real page and check event-status separately.

checks.native_scope: Isolated Android 15 emulator: real Settings page contains Airtap; launch from service succeeds; permission and listener remain disabled until normal approval. Not a Flyme notification-delivery test.
checks.fixture_failure: The existing multi-AI test harness used the older owner-page render signature. Updated it to the production signature and retained the failed run before the passing rerun.

physical_upgrade.failure_and_recovery: File-share did not offer the installer; normal browser installation succeeded. The app restart lost the task lease; the AI reacquired it and continued with the original pairing.
physical_upgrade.notification_settings_and_event_task_res: The normal notification-access page opened; authorized UI approval was followed by enabled, permission and listener_connected readback, then a real notification task.

physical_notification_workflow.event: A temporary Clock alarm produced a real notification captured by Airtap. Its stable event ID was used to start one task.
physical_notification_workflow.business_result: The AI saved a test note, closed and reopened it, verified its contents, then completed both the job and event receipt.
physical_notification_workflow.recovery: The local polling process was terminated during a request (exit 137). With the same saved cursor and job state, the next pull added no duplicate item; starting the completed event was rejected as watch_event_closed and no second phone task ran.
failure_and_recovery: An earlier browser-download marker notification was not captured. The cause is unknown; unrelated notification volume was observed, but buffer pressure was not established as the cause.
One phone action returned fresh_snapshot_required and was recorded as not applied. A new observation allowed the task to continue.
physical_notification_workflow.cleanup: The temporary alarm was removed, existing alarms were preserved, test watches were paused, and the task lease was released. No polling job or schedule remained active.
physical_notification_workflow.audio_scope: The test alarm sounded. Media, ringtone and notification streams were muted; the alarm stream had a device minimum of one. This was not a wholly silent test.
physical_notification_workflow.evidence_scope: The maintainer retrieved and read the actual sanitized receipt through the original conversation. Raw notification content and private notes are not published.
physical_notification_workflow.limits: One event and one polling-process interruption, not every app notification, cross-notification business deduplication, phone network loss, reboot or continuous unattended operation.
